name: Imran Khan Cancer Appeal USA
mission: TO GENERATE CHARITABLE DONATIONS FOR HELPING IN THE TREATMENT OF CANCER IN THIRD WORLD COUNTRIES AND THE ESTABLISHMENT OF THE SHAUKAT KHANUM MEMORIAL CANCER HOSPITAL AND RESEARCH CENTER. SPECIFIC GOALS INCLUDE (1) TO INITIATE CHARITABLE FUND RAISING ACTIVITIES, (2) TO RECRUIT PROFESSIONAL AND NON- PROFESSIONAL STAFF AND EXPENSES FOR THE ADMINISTRATIVE OFFICE, (3) TO SUPPLY FINANCIAL SUPPORT FOR THE PAYMENT OF MEDICINES, DIAGNOSTIC AND THERAPEUTIC EQUIPMENT FOR THE SHAUKAT KHANUM MEMORIAL CANCER HOSPITAL AND RESEARCH CENTER. (4) TO ASSIST IN THE RECRUITMENT OF ALL MEDICAL AND ANCILLARY PERSONNEL FOR THE SHAUKAT KHANUM MEMORIAL CANCER HOSPITAL AND RESEARCH CENTER.

strengths_deep_dive: Imran Khan Cancer Appeal USA stands out for its high operational efficiency. In FY2024, the charity achieved <cite id="1">a program expense ratio of 98.3%</cite>. This figure exceeds the 75% industry standard and beats the 87.7% peer median for global health organizations. Spend on administrative and fundraising functions remains exceptionally low. Citing official filings, <cite id="1">fundraising costs totaled $0.09 per $1 raised</cite>. Financially, the organization maintains <cite id="1">9.8 months of working capital</cite>. This reserve ensures that ongoing clinical and diagnostic care for cancer patients continues uninterrupted during revenue fluctuations.
rich_narrative.summary: Imran Khan Cancer Appeal USA supports free and subsidized cancer treatment for impoverished patients, primarily funding healthcare infrastructure and clinical care in Pakistan. In FY2024, the charity generated <cite id="3">$23,259,494 in total revenue</cite>, sustaining strong programmatic growth over recent years. The organization demonstrates exceptional fiscal discipline by directing <cite id="1">98.3% of its total functional expenses directly to program activities</cite>, easily surpassing industry benchmarks. This model allows donors to maximize the direct financial impact of their contributions. The charity holds <cite id="1">a 95/100 overall score from Charity Navigator</cite>, reflecting solid operational transparency and accountability. Operational funding actively supports clinical, diagnostic, and pharmacy services. The charity provides direct healthcare to marginalized populations who otherwise lack access to specialized oncology treatment. Furthermore, the organization operates with high financial stability, maintaining <cite id="1">9.8 months of working capital</cite> to cushion against short-term fundraising shifts. As a <cite id="2">verified zakat-eligible entity</cite>, it provides Muslim donors with a reliable pathway to fulfill religious obligations through direct medical relief.
